border_color.doc: Text outline colour as an ARGB hex literal.

color.doc: Default text colour as an ARGB hex literal, such as 0xffffffff.

effect.doc: Whether the font's shader effect is enabled.

name.doc: Font name referenced from .gui files via font = "...".

path.doc: Font file stem under gfx/fonts, without extension: path = "gfx/fonts/vic_36".

textcolors.doc: Per-colour-code font variants: the G, R, Y (and optionally H, T) blocks override the font used for each localisation colour code.

animation.doc: Animation clip bound to a pdxmesh: animation = { id = "idle_01" type = "gfx/models/x.anim" }.

cull_distance.doc: Camera distance beyond which the object stops rendering (values may carry an f suffix).

effect.doc: Shader effect for the object, a gfx/FX/*.lua file.

file.doc: Mesh file of a pdxmesh object, such as gfx/models/Units/x.mesh.

linewidth.doc: Stroke width of a LineChartType chart.

meshsettings.doc: Per-mesh material overrides for a pdxmesh.

name.doc: Object name. pdxmesh names are referenced by map ambient objects via their type blocks.

normal.doc: Normal-map texture of an arrowType map arrow.

scale.doc: Uniform scale applied to the object.

size.doc: Diameter in pixels of a PieChartType chart.
Pixel size block of a LineChartType chart: size = { x = 152 y = 40 }.

specular.doc: Specular texture of an arrowType map arrow.

speed.doc: Scroll speed of an animatedmaptext label.

textblock.doc: Rendered text of an animatedmaptext label: font, colour, and position settings.

texture.doc: Diffuse texture of an arrowType map arrow.

texturefile.doc: Texture of a tradeRouteType, relative to the game or mod root.

texturefile1.doc: First texture of a tradeRouteType arrow.

texturefile2.doc: Second texture of a tradeRouteType arrow.

texturefile3.doc: Third texture of a tradeRouteType arrow.

type.doc: Particle-system name played by a pdxparticle object.

id.doc: Animation clip name referenced by the mesh's .anim metadata.

type.doc: Animation clip bound to the state id: a shared clip name such as polearm_onehanded_attack_animation or seagulls_idle, resolved from the compiled unit animation set rather than a loose file path.

index.doc: Zero-based mesh index the settings apply to.

name.doc: Name of the sub-mesh the settings apply to.

shader.doc: Shader name used to render the sub-mesh.

shader_file.doc: Shader source file for the sub-mesh.

texture_diffuse.doc: Diffuse texture override for the sub-mesh, a bare file name resolved relative to the mesh's own directory rather than the game root.

texture_normal.doc: Normal-map texture override for the sub-mesh, a bare file name resolved relative to the mesh's own directory rather than the game root.

texture_specular.doc: Specular texture override for the sub-mesh, a bare file name resolved relative to the mesh's own directory rather than the game root.

color.doc: Text colour as an RGB float block: color = { 1.0 1.0 0.0 }.

font.doc: Bitmap font name, declared by a bitmapfont block in an interface .gfx file.

format.doc: Text alignment within the block; vanilla uses centre.

position.doc: Pixel position of the text block: position = { x = 0 y = 0 }.

alphamaskfile.doc: Alpha mask texture blended over the sprite (used by the diplomacy overlay icons).

alwaystransparent.doc: Marks the texture as fully transparent so the engine skips per-pixel transparency handling.

animation.doc: Overlay animation played over the sprite texture (rotating or scrolling effects).

animation_rate_fps.doc: Playback speed of a frameAnimatedSpriteType, in frames per second.

bordersize.doc: Corner border thickness of a corneredTileSpriteType: borderSize = { x = 2 y = 2 }.

clicksound.doc: Sound played when the sprite is clicked as a button.

color.doc: Progress bar fill colour as an RGB float block: color = { 0.0 0.5 0.0 }.

colortwo.doc: Progress bar background colour as an RGB float block.

effectfile.doc: GUI shader effect driving the sprite's button states, named after a gfx/FX shader such as buttonstate. The engine resolves the compiled shader by name, so the historical .lua spelling of these references no longer exists on disk even in vanilla.

horizontal.doc: Whether a progress bar fills horizontally instead of vertically.

legacy_lazy_load.doc: Legacy flag restoring the pre-lazy-loading texture lifetime for the sprite.

loadtype.doc: When the texture is loaded: FRONTEND sprites load for the main menu, INGAME sprites load with a campaign.

looping.doc: Whether a frameAnimatedSpriteType restarts after the last frame.

name.doc: Sprite name. All sprite kinds share one lookup namespace: GUI elements, mission icons, and event pictures reference this name regardless of the defining block kind.

noofframes.doc: Number of frames stacked vertically in the texture; the engine crops the sprite to one frame and advances on demand.

norefcount.doc: Keeps the texture permanently loaded by skipping reference counting.

overlay_frames_per_row.doc: Columns in the overlay frame grid of a masked shield.

overlay_rows.doc: Rows in the overlay frame grid of a masked shield.

pause_on_loop.doc: Seconds a frameAnimatedSpriteType rests on the last frame before looping.

play_on_show.doc: Whether a frameAnimatedSpriteType starts playing when its window becomes visible.

size.doc: Pixel size block of a cornered tile sprite: size = { x = 10 y = 10 }.

texturefile.doc: Path of the texture file, relative to the game or mod root. Forward and back slashes are both accepted; the file must exist (a .tga reference may fall back to a shipped .dds).

texturefile1.doc: First texture of a progress bar or masked shield: the fill texture revealed as the bar advances.

texturefile2.doc: Second texture of a progress bar or masked shield: the background texture being masked.

texturefile3.doc: Third texture of a masked shield or trade route: the overlay texture blended on top.

transparencecheck.doc: Whether the engine tests the texture for transparent pixels (disable for full-frame textures).

animationblendmode.doc: Blend mode used when drawing the animation over the sprite.

animationdelay.doc: Seconds the animation waits before starting.

animationframes.doc: Frame count of the animation texture.

animationlooping.doc: Whether the animation restarts after its last frame.

animationmaskfile.doc: Mask restricting where the animation texture is drawn.

animationrotation.doc: Rotations per second applied to the animation texture.

animationrotationoffset.doc: Initial rotation angle of the animation texture, in radians.

animationtexturefile.doc: Texture scrolled or rotated over the sprite by the animation.

animationtexturescale.doc: Scale factor applied to the animation texture.

animationtime.doc: Duration of one scrolling or rotating animation cycle of the animated overlay, in seconds.

animationtype.doc: Motion of the animated overlay: scrolling (the vanilla default), rotating, or pulsing.

bitmapfonts.doc: Wrapper block containing bitmap font definitions.

objectTypes.doc: Wrapper block containing engine object definitions (pdxmesh, arrows, particles, map text, charts).

spriteTypes.doc: Wrapper block containing all sprite definitions (spriteType, textSpriteType, progress bars, shields, animated sprites).

bitmapfont.doc: Bitmap font definition: name plus texture atlas path and colour tables.

LineChartType.doc: Line chart object sized in pixels with a line width.

PieChartType.doc: Pie chart object sized in pixels.

animatedmaptext.doc: Floating map text label with a scroll speed and one or more textblock style blocks.

arrowType.doc: Map arrow object: texture, normal, and specular maps plus the arrow shader effect.

pdxmesh.doc: Mesh object referencing a .mesh file with optional animations and texture overrides.

pdxparticle.doc: Particle system object driven by a named particle type.

tradeRouteType.doc: Trade route object: arrow texture set and a cull distance.

corneredTileSpriteType.doc: Tiled sprite whose corners stay fixed while edges and centre stretch (size and bordersize).

cursor_offset.doc: Global cursor hotspot offset for every edit box: cursor_offset = { -5 -4 }.

frameAnimatedSpriteType.doc: Frame-by-frame animated sprite (animation_rate_fps, looping, play_on_show, pause_on_loop).

maskedShieldType.doc: Shield sprite masking texturefile with an overlay grid (texturefile3, overlay_frames_per_row, overlay_rows).

progressbartype.doc: Progress bar sprite: texturefile1 fill over texturefile2 background, coloured through color and colortwo.

spriteType.doc: Plain sprite: one texture file with optional frame slicing and load behaviour.

textSpriteType.doc: Sprite whose texture is rendered behind dynamic text (names, numbers).
